scope: 1.1.1-debug FT232RL wake and UART transmission repair

user_observations.requested_scan_scope: Honda K-Line Keihin and Shindengen without requiring a catalog ID

source_findings: The previous optional wake returned on its first unexpected byte and purged RX/TX before UART completion was established.
USB bulk acceptance did not establish completion on the 10400-baud UART.
Data UART faults from an optional one-way wake incorrectly aborted the scan before diagnostic entry.
changes: FTDI USB protocol is now exercised directly by JVM fixtures, with Android acting as an endpoint adapter.
Confirm asynchronous bit-bang TXD LOW/HIGH with SIO_READ_PINS before hold timing and switching back to UART.
Preserve 70 ms LOW and 130 ms HIGH settling; restore UART idle on cancelled/failed setup and close.
Apply 10400 baud, 8N1, no flow control and the correct FT232R divisor index after mode changes.
Wait a conservative complete-frame wire duration, then poll fresh THRE/TEMT modem status within the write timeout.
A failed or uncertain transmission cannot append another frame until full reinitialization.
Ordinary purge discards RX only; initialization and teardown reset the UART deliberately.
Optional one-way wake drains its full receive window up to 60 ms, recording discarded UART data errors.
USB transport errors and diagnostic entry/sensor/DTC data faults remain fatal or subject to the existing bounded retry.
ECU connection still requires a real valid diagnostic reply; identity is optional and does not restrict scan by vendor.

red_regression.baseline_failure: Gagal pada wake-up ECU setelah 1 percobaan. FTDI melaporkan kesalahan UART (LSR 0x68); sampel tidak digunakan.

reference_evidence.kind: Reused original-extension scripted FTDI observation and ordinary shell/source inspection; no new REA Evidence claimed
reference_evidence.original_init_observed: 70 ms between LOW/HIGH writes and 130 ms before final purge, bit-bang mask/mode 1/1, 10400 baud
reference_evidence.rea_cli_doctor: 6.8.0: no active REA MCP registration; retained observations reused without configuration repair

remaining_unknowns: Physical cause of FE being observed as FC is not proven by the trace or scripted fixtures.
FTDI pin/status reports do not measure K-Line voltage or timing at the ECU connector.
Physical operation on the user's Shindengen and on every Keihin/Honda K-Line model requires device retesting.

latest_physical_test.wake_rx: Repeated FF/FC GPIO samples remain after returning to UART
latest_physical_test.power_description_from_user: K-Line board has 12 V and GND; FTDI is connected with GND/VCC/RX/TX and set to 5 V. Exact power routing unknown.
